items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: Man sometimes Cleven Williams would be playing them dances there, different bands, good bands, you know what I mean.

ctx.x: Flaxseed, what was it? Flaxseed? Flaxseed, yeah you see, I tell her, we was playing in the country, you see. We used to go to play in the country, or we used to go, you see like holidays coming there now? Yeah. We would miss playing all them holidays in the country, you see. So the boy we was playing for, this boy Sero, you know he came from that St. James Parish, you know. Oh yeah. Well this boy, him and this boy grew up together, see. Well every time we'd have a dance ball we'd high in the play. So we'd go,…
